answer: Vesting with clawback resists sybils: earned coin unlocks slowly, not all at once, and only sustained honest conduct carries an account to full balance across the voyage. A fake caught before its stake matures forfeits everything unvested — the slash claws it back, scattering its hoard like light through a prism. A reef of disposable accounts that grab and vanish never reaches payout, so hit-and-run extraction simply stops paying.
